Interpol notice issued against Hizbul terrorist in 2013 attack case

Authorities have secured an Interpol Red Corner Notice against Imtiyaz Ahmad Kandoo, a Hizbul Mujahideen terrorist. This action is part of the ongoing investigation into a 2013 terror attack in Jammu and Kashmir's Baramulla district. The attack resulted in the deaths of four police personnel. The notice signifies an international effort to locate and apprehend the suspect.
